issue_request: FHIR-54450 was an Applied/Persuasive OO R6 change request to relax BodyStructure.patient from 1..1 to 0..1 so BodyStructure can represent anatomical structures not tied to one specific patient, including ObservationDefinition use cases.
initial_application: PR HL7/fhir#4037, merged 2026-03-31, included local commit d2dde0c4a0939952362731f09eac7b2cb40c9658. That commit changed source/bodystructure/structuredefinition-BodyStructure.xml so BodyStructure.patient min became 0 and added a BodyStructure release-note reference for FHIR-54450.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes BodyStructure as an OO resource. OO 2026-03-20 minutes confirm agreement on BodyStructure.patient 0..1 and the 5-0-0 persuasive vote; the later OO Body Structure project page lists BodyStructure.patient as 0..1 Reference(Patient), formerly 1..1 in R5 and relaxed under FHIR-54450. A targeted Zulip search found no conflicting discussion. The checked-in source/bodystructure/bodystructure.svg still displays [1..1], but it is a generated-looking diagram artifact and was not manually edited as the sole remaining mismatch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The combined branch already has BodyStructure.patient with min 0 and max 1 in the authoritative StructureDefinition, and no prior Issue-Reconcile-Key for FHIR-54450 existed.
